## Checklist

- [ ] Change is consistent with [`docs/SPECIFICATION.md`](../docs/SPECIFICATION.md) and accepted ADRs
- [ ] Any architecture-relevant decision is captured in an ADR (status `proposed` or accepted) — or none is needed per the calibration rule in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)
- [ ] A new/changed `proposed` ADR ships in its own PR, with its `Enforcement` section filled — only the acceptance may accompany implementation ([`AGENTS.md` §3](../AGENTS.md#3-adr-rules))
- [ ] The ADR index in [`docs/adr/README.md`](../docs/adr/README.md) is updated if an ADR was added, superseded, or changed status
- [ ] A specification change names the accepted ADRs whose basis it moves ([`AGENTS.md` §3](../AGENTS.md#3-adr-rules))
- [ ] A structural change updates [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) ([`AGENTS.md` §5](../AGENTS.md#5-quality-bar--definition-of-done))
- [ ] Uses the project vocabulary consistently ([`AGENTS.md` §3](../AGENTS.md#3-adr-rules))
- [ ] All artifacts (code, comments, docs) are in English ([`AGENTS.md` §4](../AGENTS.md#4-working-style))
- [ ] Build and tests pass locally ([`AGENTS.md` §5](../AGENTS.md#5-quality-bar--definition-of-done))
